text:
The night comes naked:

moon breasts,
purple gloves.

With arms raised
I am already waiting for her.
How close to my ear
her lips fall silent!

Love, love!
Death
is kissing me.

translation.title: The Night Comes Naked

Translated directly from the supplied Spanish source; no separate editorial review occurred.
